title: ipayx.ai/developers/sandbox
snippet:
# iPayX FX Proof API
Audit FX transactions against the mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread, true cost, and an FX score (1–10).
Base URL
`https://api.ipayx.ai/v1`
Authentication
`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_…`
POST
`/audit`
Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request. The API fetches the mid-market rate at the time of each transaction, computes the spread and implicit cost, and returns an FX execution score for the batch.

- Soft monthly limits apply per plan: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered. Above the soft limit, an `X-Usage-Warning` header is returned.

## First request
Direct API endpoint. Custom domain api.ipayx.ai coming soon.
bash
```
# POST /v1/audit — see "Partner Rate Comparison" section for optional partner_rate field
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
"transactions": [
{
"id": "tx_001",
"source_currency": "USD",
"target_currency": "EUR",
"source_amount": 1000000,
"target_amount": 1018900,
"trade_timestamp": "2026-04-15T14:30:00Z"
}
]
}'
```
